command: set +e; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/tmp/npm-ci.log 2>&1; ci=$?; cat /tmp/npm-ci.log; test $ci -eq 0 || exit $ci; npm run test:run >/tmp/vitest-baseline.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -n 160 /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; echo VITEST_BASELINE_RC=$rc; test $rc -ne 0; grep -q '49 failed' /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; grep -q '48 failed' /tmp/vitest-baseline.log; exit $?
